## Source: amazon-inspector (93b751049f78b324983511537b6c053a0ed080639dd7c447d87494eabc134ba3)
On import, __init__.py archives the installer's Telegram Desktop tdata directory (%APPDATA%/Telegram Desktop/tdata) into a zip named 'aiosendletter_logs' and POSTs it to a hardcoded Cloudflare Workers endpoint at https://red-poetry-6b6f.martinmcflywork.workers.dev/. The tdata directory holds Telegram session keys; uploading it enables full account takeover of the installer's Telegram account. The behavior is disguised with misleading identifiers ('aiosendletter_logs', 'aioletter initialized') and empty except-block prints that silently swallow errors, and the stated package purpose ('a library filled with books') is unrelated to Telegram.

## Source: kam193 (5a4369fbf36c4c2a54c7555febeaf8fda122d33a7ba9b9d11e77031849f5c7d8)
Package hides code to exfiltrate files. Most releases target unclear files, but some reveal the goal to exfiltrate sensitive Telegram data.
